messages:
Maya CSM: dropping a compact 'greenroom' runbook for small/medium go-lives. aim: make prefill+streaming steps repeatable and reduce renewal churn. short + prescriptive.
Diego CS: yes please. can we keep it to 5 checkpoints and a 3-question feedback card? cs teams love short lists.
Maya CSM: exactly. proposed checkpoints: preflight signals, hydration pulse, adaptive-prefill, streaming sanity, escalation & capture.
Anita Eng: runtime notes: hydration pulse: 90s small, 4m medium. adaptive-prefill: initial batch window=200ms, max_batch_size=12. set concurrency cap=2 per-tenant for first 24h.
Maya CSM: adding those numbers. also a quick warm probe command for handoffs so CS can run during demo:
```bash
# warm probe: count warm replicas and tag traces
redwoodctl pools list --tenant=$TENANT --filter=warm --format=count && 
curl -s -X POST $CONSOLE/internal/run-warmprobe -d "tenant=$TENANT" -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN"
```
Diego CS: nice. add a one-liner for the customer: "send 3 sample queries as a warmup instead of bulk prefill" — cheaper and warms KV.
Maya CSM: yes. UX tip added.
Anita Eng: telemetry: require header `x-rw-cs:greenroom-<tenant>` for all handoff traffic. we can auto-generate a 24h health card slice.
Maya CSM: step 1 (preflight signals): watch these 1m metrics: active_rps, median_latency_ms, prefill_hit_rate, early_token_err_rate. compute a simple guard score:
`guard = clamp( (0.5*(1 - prefill_hit_rate)) + (0.3*early_token_err_rate_norm) + (0.2*latency_norm), 0, 1 )`
Anita Eng: normalize early_token_err_rate by 0.01 (so 1% -> 1.0) and latency_norm by 1000ms (so 500ms->0.5). thresholds we recommend: guard>0.35 => execute escalation.
Diego CS: escalation steps for CS-run: 1) run warm probe, 2) flip throttled-prefill (reduce batch window to 100ms), 3) open support case and invite eng, 4) offer 15min dedicated burst if available.
Maya CSM: adding fallback: if streaming disconnects >0.8% sustained for 8m, switch to non-streaming mode and annotate the case.
Anita Eng: add guidance for quantization: for chat flows set profile=latency-first; for high-quality long generations set profile=balanced.
Maya CSM: feedback capture card (to send to customer at T+30m):
"""
Quick feedback (30m): 1) Was output aligned with your expectations? 2) Any repeated truncation or timeouts? 3) Which 1 prompt should we prefill next?
"""
Diego CS: perfect. also request customers to paste any sample error IDs so eng can correlate traces.
ops-bot: sys: greenroom preflight run for tenant demo-88 at 2801112900 completed :white_check_mark: (warm replicas=2)
Maya CSM: great. final TL;DR for customer-facing handout: "Run the greenroom probe, send 3 sample warmups, enable adaptive-prefill defaults, monitor guard score for 1m signals, and follow escalation checklist if guard>0.35. Capture client feedback at 30m."
Anita Eng: I'll add a console quick-action to run the probe + auto-tag header. will post link when live.
Diego CS: once link is up i'll run this with the next handoff. short, actionable, love it.
Maya CSM: thanks team ":thumbsup:". i'll convert to playbook entry and attach the quick-action link when Anita posts it.
